name: Hanweir
description: Torens's hometown in Gavony, which was swallowed and left an empty pit.

timeline.summary: In a flashback, twelve-year-old Torens pickpockets gold in Hanweir and his brother Elamon rescues him.
timeline.quote: Elamon snatched the coins and tossed them back at the wealthy man.

timeline.summary: In a flashback to the town watch era, Torens, now twenty-one, flees a contraband deal when Elamon arrests him.
timeline.quote: he picked up the stein and whipped its contents into Elamon's face

timeline.summary: In a flashback, Torens returns to Hanweir to find the entire town gone and reads Elamon's letter too late.
timeline.quote: as if the entire town, all at once, had been gouged out of the earth

timeline.summary: Tam reaches an inn and learns from Moiren about the Travails and how cathars killed the Town.
timeline.quote: "My uncle died the day the town became the Town.

pages_say.description: The moorlands where Grete's friends hunt the last of the ghouls.
A village rumored destroyed, fused people and village into a single entity.
Torens's hometown in Gavony, which was swallowed and left an empty pit.
A town that merged into a monstrous Town and was slain by cathars.
